text: perform_statistical_tests() analyzes filtered RPM matrix using nonparametric methods. two independent groups, function performs Wilcoxon rank-sum test. two groups, performs Kruskal-Wallis test can calculate Dunn post-hoc comparisons. complete result table includes raw adjusted p-values together descriptive effect-size information. title: Perform non-parametric differential-expression analysis — perform_statistical_tests
text: Performs rank-based differential-expression analysis normalized miRNA expression matrix. Two-group comparisons use Mann-Whitney-Wilcoxon rank-sum test. Comparisons involving three groups use Kruskal-Wallis test followed Dunn post-hoc comparisons.

title: Perform non-parametric differential-expression analysis — perform_statistical_tests

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Reorganized miRPM standard R package documented public functions, automated tests, continuous integration, pkgdown website. Added synthetic miRPM_example dataset reproducible examples, package testing, documentation. Added multi-platform R CMD check workflows released, development, previous R versions Linux, macOS, Windows.

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Updated normalize_rpm() normalize complete miRNA count matrices using sample-specific library sizes. default, library sizes calculated complete column sums input count matrix. Added support externally calculated, named library sizes. Added validation count matrices, sample names, library sizes, normalization inputs. Added normalization metadata returned RPM matrix.

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Redesigned filter_mirnas() combine RPM abundance, raw-count, prevalence, minimum-sample criteria. Added filtering across samples, group, groups, specified minimum number groups. Added detailed filtering diagnostics summary information. Retained selected compatibility arguments original interface.

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Redesigned perform_statistical_tests() nonparametric group comparisons filtered RPM data. Added Wilcoxon rank-sum testing two independent groups. Added Kruskal-Wallis testing Dunn post-hoc comparisons analyses involving two groups. Added multiple-testing correction, including Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate adjustment. Added descriptive statistics, effect-size information, structured result tables. Added optional Excel export allowing analyses run without writing files.

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Redesigned miRNA_expression_plot() generate static ggplot2 graphics interactive plotly visualizations. Redesigned individual_miRNA_plot() generate one expression plot per selected miRNA. Added sample alignment, group selection, color validation, tooltip information, optional file export. Functions now return structured objects containing plots, data, selected miRNAs, missing miRNAs, groups, output paths.

title: miRPM 0.2.0
text: Added pkgdown website Home, Reference, License sections. Expanded README complete normalization, filtering, statistical analysis, visualization workflow. Documented orientation alignment requirements count matrices sample metadata. Clarified RPM transparent abundance-scaling method replacement count-based differential-expression models.
